title: Close M7 formal research and coverage document work package
commitMessage: docs: qualify M7 W02 research and document closure

contribution.summary: Qualify and close the accepted M7-W02 work package after independently verifying both completed formal-research and owner-coverage document phases, four tasks, twelve Q/O/D children, four scientific/documentary receipts and the 541-node native plan. Preserve separate M7 release and external recipient gates.
contribution.value: A BCL-only read-only checker verifies the RS121 first-pass report; source SHA pins for C01/C02 T1/T2 and prior W01 research; 106 accepted requirement IDs, 20 source entries, six dispositions; and all W02 child nodes. Three AURA/Decision/MCDM drafts remain unsent, advanced/formal providers deferred and public product flags false. Only the M7-W02 parent transitions to done with a new source-pinned receipt; M7 stays in progress.
debtChanges: W02 completion covers accepted research and documentation, not a shipped general proof kernel, public formal APIs or all Math requirements as implemented products.
AURA, Decision and MCDM requests remain draft/unsent and require recipient revision, authorization, compatibility, provenance and rollback evidence.
Precision, tensor, DAG, PlotModel and proof-provider research retains named-consumer, source-free, rights, resource and trusted-base acceptance gates.
The M7 1.2.0-candidate release, publication/rights decision and future program remain unapproved; no external or sibling mutation is authorized.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS122 success, independently review the M7 G-M7 milestone gate, scientific reproducibility, source rights and public distribution authority. Do not infer publication, recipient adoption or new roadmap approval from completed research/document scope.

achievements.achievement: Close the two accepted M7-W02 formal research and coverage document phases as one source-pinned work package, preserving explicit external deferrals and an open M7 release gate.
